## Supply ghosts through layout exchange (`SyncOptions`) {#sec-ch11-exchange}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0
status: draft
-->

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Use layout exchange for seams and periodic neighbours. Cubed-sphere field exchange can interpolate and rotate vector components; raw limiter exchange avoids interpolation.
Default: interpolate false; skip_corner true.
Order: exact discrete operation or local derivation below; coupled solver order not measured.
:::

### Derivation

This is a pointer section: interpolation weights and coordinate transforms belong to the geometry
chapter, and communication scheduling belongs to the parallel chapter. Here the directly implemented corner
identity is the arithmetic average of two edge strips. For generic values $q$ already in the destination frame,

$$
q^{\mathrm{corner}}=\tfrac12(q^{\mathrm{edge1}}+q^{\mathrm{edge2}}).
$$ {#eq-ch11-exchange-corner}

`fill_corners` ([`layout.cpp:710-740`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/layout/layout.cpp#L710-L740)) implements @eq-ch11-exchange-corner by broadcasting adjacent strips. The weights
sum to one, so constants are preserved exactly in real arithmetic; this does not prove a two-dimensional
interpolation order. C4 checks this constant-preservation identity and records why nonconstant edge values
need not reconstruct the corner value.

The report-only checks are `src/snapy_report/ch11/boundary_check.py`; their current output is
`src/snapy_report/ch11/boundary_check.out`. They do not call a snapy kernel.

### Numerical method

For subdivided cubed-sphere panels, interpolated exchange first completes raw intra-panel exchange,
then cross-panel exchange, and finally synthesizes skipped corners. This ensures the widened panel donor
strip contains its tangential halo. `interp_ghost` widens the strip with `cs_interp_margin`; deserialization
interpolates when requested and rotates conserved or primitive vector components. The hydro donor factor
uses `interpolate(false)` with scalar type. This is a data-ownership map; no measured seam order is claimed.

@fig-ch11-exchange-stencil illustrates the operations, with labelled roles independent of colour.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch11-exchange-stencil
#| fig-cap: "Supply ghosts through layout exchange. Schematic only; no simulation measurements."
#| fig-alt: "Labelled schematic of the exchange boundary operation; ghosts and owned cells have separate text labels."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch11.fig_exchange_stencil import make_fig
make_fig()
```

: Implementation sites for exchange. {#tbl-ch11-exchange-code}

1. Read sync flags; defaults do not interpolate and do skip corners. The anchor `skip_corner` is in [`layout.hpp:149-154`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/layout/layout.hpp#L149-L154).
2. For the subdivided interpolated panel path, finish intra-panel exchange before packing cross-panel donors. The anchor `exchange_ghost_zones` is in [`meshblock.cpp:545-572`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L545-L572).
3. Deserialize, interpolate when selected, transform vector components, and fill synthetic corners when requested. The anchor `interp_ghost` is in [`cubed_sphere_layout.cpp:922-956`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/layout/cubed_sphere_layout.cpp#L922-L956).
4. Keep raw scalar donor-factor exchange separate from interpolated hydro exchange. The anchor `interpolate` is in [`hydro_forward.cpp:673-680`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L673-L680).

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The corner average is not the panel-edge interpolation formula. CPU/CUDA equality assertions in the panel
suite do not establish multi-process coverage. The vertical-velocity exchange suite checks its own
`ideal_match` criterion ([`test_cubed_sphere_vertical_velocity_exchange.py:81-109`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/tests/test_cubed_sphere_vertical_velocity_exchange.py#L81-L109)); no result is claimed without a run. Broader seam flux and positivity
coverage belongs to the geometry and switch-matrix chapters.

Untested switch combinations remain subject to @sec-ch12-matrix. No new CPU, CUDA or multi-rank solver result is claimed.
:::
